records.title: Barriers to Discrete Reasoning with Transformers: A Survey Across Depth, Exactness, and Bandwidth
records.reason: This survey analyzes theoretical barriers to discrete reasoning, including memory-bandwidth constraints, but does not introduce or benchmark a system-level inference optimization. A survey-led lineage link is weak.

records.title: Incentivizing In-depth Reasoning over Long Contexts with Process Advantage Shaping
records.reason: Process Advantage Shaping trains deeper reasoning over long contexts; evaluation concerns reasoning quality, not inference compute, memory, latency, or serving.

records.title: CALM: Culturally Self-Aware Language Models
records.reason: CALM studies culturally self-aware language models and MoE modeling for cultural representation. It does not evaluate inference efficiency or serving improvements.

records.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
records.reason: OPSD-V post-trains few-step autoregressive video generators with cache-aware teacher supervision; it preserves the same sampler, number of denoising steps, and inference KV-cache path. Quality improves without extra inference work, but it does not itself reduce inference cost.
